entities.name: Fungal Uba4
observations: 498-aa query matches reviewed Aspergillus Uba4 proteins over 100% of the sequence at 68.5–70.0% identity (E-values 1.16e-240 to 3.43e-240); function transfer is homology-supported.
Sequence-derived estimates: mass 53.78 kDa, pI 6.28, GRAVY -0.210; these do not account for modifications or bound partners.
Pfam finds ThiF domain at residues 68–323 and Rhodanese domain at residues 379–489.

Reviewed fungal homolog annotations describe Uba4 as an E1-like adenylyltransferase/sulfurtransferase that activates URM1 and MOCS2A sulfur carriers and transfers sulfur for C-terminal thiocarboxylation; associated with tRNA wobble uridine 2-thiolation and molybdopterin biosynthesis.
Reviewed fungal homologs are annotated cytosolic and zinc-binding; these properties are inferred for this query by homology, not directly measured.

entities.name: tRNA wobble thiolation
observations: Reviewed fungal Uba4 homologs participate in 2-thiolation of wobble-position uridines in cytosolic tRNAs, including tRNA-Lys, tRNA-Glu, and tRNA-Gln; applicability to query is homology-based.

entities.name: Molybdopterin biosynthesis
observations: Reviewed fungal Uba4 homologs support sulfur-carrier thiocarboxylation associated with molybdopterin cofactor biosynthesis; applicability to query is homology-based.
